name: Sonnet dividend growth and income
strategy: Trend-confirmation sector rotation: ride accelerating relative-strength moves in financials/healthcare/biotech while pressing the breakdown in gold/miners and crypto majors via shorts, harvesting momentum carry rather than dividend yield.
novelty: This is a relative-value/trend-harvesting book, not a dividend or quality-cash-flow strategy: it goes long sectors showing fresh 1-3mo acceleration (financials, biotech, regional banks, healthcare) and shorts assets in confirmed multi-month breakdowns (gold/miners rolling over -13%/-24%, crypto majors in deep downtrends) using perps for capital-efficient short carry. Unlike R1 (defensive/cyclical dividend growers) or R2 (AI dividend growth + short of one overextended leveraged ETF), there is no dividend-yield selection criterion at all here, no AI theme, and the short leg is diversified across gold and crypto trend breakdowns rather than a single leveraged-momentum squeeze bet.

positions.thesis: Financials showing sharp 1m acceleration (+6.0%) with steady 3m/12m trend; sector rotation into banks/rates beneficiaries.
Biotech breaking out with +14.6% 1m surge atop strong 3m/6m/12m trend; momentum inflection in a laggard-turned-leader.
Regional banks confirming financials rotation with +5.5% 1m and consistent multi-period gains.
Healthcare re-accelerating (+4.0% 1m) after a soft 6m, defensive-cyclical rotation candidate alongside biotech strength.
Gold miners in a confirmed breakdown: -13.2% 1m, -24.3% 3m, -23.6% 6m; pressing the trend reversal from a prior multi-year rally.
Gold itself rolling over (-6.1% 1m, -15.5% 3m) after an extended run; miners' breakdown corroborates a cycle turn.
Deep, broad-based crypto downtrend (-46.5% 6m, -56.2% 12m) with no reversal signal; pressing continuation on the weakest major.
ETH in a persistent multi-month downtrend (-19.8% 3m, -43.2% 6m); shorting confirmed weakness rather than chasing a bounce.
Small duration ballast against equity long-book beta and as a hedge if risk sectors reverse sharply.

outlook: Expect continued sector rotation into financials/healthcare/biotech as AI-momentum names (XLK/SMH) cool off, while gold/miners and crypto majors extend their established downtrends through year-end; positioned to harvest both legs of that divergence with stops to cap trend-reversal risk.
